name: print-social-techno-party-posts-black-white-cyan-red-blocks
title: 'Techno Party' pack in black and white with cyan-red colour blocks and small rotated letter marks
whatItIs: Five square posts alternating black and white, each with bold black 'Techno Party' type, thin cyan and red rectangle accents along one edge, small rotated single-letter marks (q, j, t) in corners, and 'Party About To Start' with body copy.
whatItMeans: Raw and confident; sparse colour blocks and rotated letter marks give a minimal layout underground club credibility.
techniques: Use thin colour-block strokes along one edge only.
Add small rotated single letters as a cryptic brand detail.
Alternate black and white backgrounds within one set.

vocabulary.definition: A single character rotated and placed as a small graphic detail.
A thin bar of colour used as a structural accent.
